home.title: Book your class
home.subtitle: Book your next sports session — from boxing to yoga.
home.whatBody: Classo is the easiest way to discover and book sports classes near you. Browse trainings from independent trainers — boxing, yoga, HIIT, footvolley and more — filter by location, and reserve your spot in seconds. Whether you're just starting out or training for years, there's a class around the corner for you.

about.title: About Classo
about.subtitle: The easiest way to find and book sports classes near you.
about.intro: Classo connects people who want to move with the trainers and coaches who make it happen. From boxing and yoga to footvolley on the beach, you discover classes in your neighbourhood and book a spot in just a few clicks.
about.mission: Our mission is to make sport accessible and social. We give independent trainers a simple platform to fill their classes, and give participants a clear overview of what's happening around them.

values.title: Local first
values.body: Search by address or city and find classes right around the corner.

values.title: For every level
values.body: From first-timers to seasoned athletes — there's a class for everyone.

values.title: Fair to trainers
values.body: Trainers keep control of their schedule, capacity and pricing.

about.ctaBody: Browse the available classes or get in touch with any questions.
